title: Frustratingly Easy Majority Voting Using Length Conditioning
abstract: arXiv:2610.19890v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Majority Voting (MV) is a simple and widely used strategy which improves the reasoning accuracy of Large Language Models (LLMs) by allocating additional inference-time computation. Specifically, in MV multiple Chain-of-Thoughts (CoTs) are independently sampled and the most frequent final answer is selected. In this work, we propose Length-Conditioned Majority Voting (LCMV), a Test-Time Training approach which improves MV leveraging an empirical observation that has recently been established in several studies: longer CoTs tend to be associated with a lower probability of correctness. We formulate this inductive bias as a length-conditioned prior probability, which is modeled by a simple logistic function. Moreover, we adapt this prior at test time using only unlabeled testing data and without fine-tuning the LLM. Finally, the adapted prior is used to weight the vote of each sampled answer. translated_title: 基于长度条件化的简单得令人惊讶的多数投票方法
translated_abstract: 多数投票（MV）是一种简单且广泛使用的策略，通过分配额外的推理时计算来提高大语言模型（LLM）的推理准确性。具体而言，在多数投票中，独立采样多个思维链（CoT），并选择出现频率最高的最终答案。在这项工作中，我们提出了长度条件化多数投票（LCMV），这是一种测试时训练方法，它利用了近期多项研究所确立的一个实证观察：较长的思维链往往与较低的正确概率相关。我们将这种归纳偏置表述为长度条件化的先验概率，该先验概率由一个简单的逻辑斯蒂函数建模。此外，我们仅使用未标记的测试数据在测试时自适应地调整这一先验，而无需对LLM进行微调。最后，调整后的先验被用于对每个采样答案的投票进行加权。我们在多个LLM和推理基准上进行了大量实验……
tldr: 提出长度条件化多数投票（LCMV），利用“较长的思维链正确概率更低”这一经验观察，通过逻辑函数建模长度条件化先验，并仅在测试时使用无标签数据自适应调整该先验来加权各答案的投票，无需微调LLM即可显著提升推理准确性。
en_tdlr: Proposes Length-Conditioned Majority Voting (LCMV), a test-time training approach that leverages the observation that longer Chain-of-Thoughts tend to be less correct, modeling a length-conditioned prior with a simple logistic function and adapting it on unlabeled test data without LLM fine-tuning to weight votes and improve reasoning accuracy.
